title: docs(spec): demo-staff and dev-login prose state the measured seed behaviour and point at demoStaff
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBD535BtxqcqchrhyxX7HFcR)_
Fixes #26424

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 只改文字。`demoStaff` 的 TSDoc 不再说种子写入的 `sys_user` 行会被拒(ADR-0092);`devLogins` 的三条拒收提示、文件头 TSDoc 和 `email` 描述不再教作者在 `data` 里种账号,改为指向 `demoStaff`。
- **为什么改:** 运行时实测:种子写入以系统上下文执行,身份写守卫让行,这行会落库,但没有凭据、登录不了。旧文字一处说"会被拒",一处教人去种它,两处都和实际不符,AI 作者会照抄。
- **风险与回滚:** 无 schema、键或行为变化;只有 prose 和一条拒收提示的措辞变了。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/spec/src/system/dev-login.zod.ts`(guidance 三条 + email 描述)、`packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts`(L14-20)、`content/docs/references/system/dev-login.mdx`(重生成)。
- **两分钟验证:** `git grep -n 'in \`data\`' -- packages/spec/src/system/dev-login.zod.ts` 应无输出;`git grep -n 'refused (ADR-0092)' -- packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts` 应无输出。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts`: the TSDoc sentence that said a `sys_user` row written through `data` "is refused (ADR-0092)" now states the measured behaviour. Every seed write runs under the system execution context, which ADR-0092's identity-write guard stands aside for, so the row lands. It lands as a directory row with no account and cannot sign in.
- `packages/spec/src/system/dev-login.zod.ts`: the three `guidance` prescriptions (`permissions`, `capabilities`, `seed`) stop telling the author to seed the account in `data`. They tell the author to declare the person in `demoStaff`, so that `os dev` creates the account.
- **Surface additions, accepted by seat 1 at claim time:** the same file's header TSDoc ("What it is NOT", which listed "`data` fixtures" as the way to have the account) and the `email` field's `.describe()` ("an account this application seeds") now point at `demoStaff` too. These were added because the `guidance` strings do not reach the generated reference. Only field `.describe()` text renders there, so without the `email` change the regenerated `dev-login.mdx` would not have moved.
- `content/docs/references/system/dev-login.mdx`: regenerated (`gen:docs`). Its `email` row now names `demoStaff`.
- `.changeset/26424-demo-staff-dev-login-seed-prose.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`, with both declaration lines.

No schema, key or behaviour change.

## Why

The two files pointed in opposite directions, and both were wrong about what happens. `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` writes every seed insert with `SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT` (`isSystem: true`). `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/identity-write-guard.ts` bypasses `isSystem` writes. `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.seed.test.ts` pins a `sys_user` seed row being inserted. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-admin-seed-gate.ts` records the consequence end to end: 13 `sys_user` rows, zero `sys_account` rows, and sign-in answering 401. An author who follows the old `devLogins` text gets a person who cannot sign in. `demoStaff` exists for this case.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` at `4b28e265`, under `os-verify-lock`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 728 passed (728), Tests 22040 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` at `4b28e265`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour. It changes prose and one refusal prescription's wording, and no test pins that wording.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance: `git grep -n 'refused (ADR-0092)' -- packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts` gives 0 lines. `git grep -n 'in \`data\`' -- packages/spec/src/system/dev-login.zod.ts` gives 0 lines. Control leg: `git grep -c 'through \`data\`'` on the same file gives 2, so the grep reads the file. `git grep -c demoStaff` on `dev-login.zod.ts` gives 5.
- Premise correction: the card says the three strings at L67/L71/L73 are `.describe()` text that reaches `dev-login.mdx`. They are `strictObject` `guidance` entries, which are shown in an unknown-key refusal and not in the generated reference. The text that reached the reference was the `email` description, which is why it joined the surface.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:446` still says the row "is refused (ADR-0092)". That sentence belongs to PR #26420's patch round and is left untouched here.

## Verification

<details><summary>Refusal prescription as an author sees it (built dist)</summary>

`DevLoginSchema.safeParse({ email: 'a@b.co', seed: true })` now answers:

```text
Unrecognized key(s) on a `devLogins` entry: `seed`.
  • a `devLogins` entry creates no account. Declare the person in `demoStaff` — `os dev` creates the account so it can sign in — and name it here so the banner can print it. A `sys_user` row seeded through `data` has no credential and cannot sign in. This key is new in @objectstack/spec 17.5 and strict from birth — an unknown key here was never accepted.
```

</details>
